name: Dental Education Videos
author: Toothority Patient Education

sections.description:
Turn your website into a patient education powerhouse. Dental Education Videos gives you instant access to a growing library of over 40 peer-reviewed, beautifully produced 4K videos covering implants, crowns, root canals, whitening, orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, and more.

Just pick a video, drop it on any page, and let it do the explaining for you.

Patients Who Understand Say Yes

When patients can see exactly what a procedure involves, they feel informed, confident, and ready to move forward. Practices using patient education videos report higher case acceptance and fewer no-shows.

Stop Repeating Yourself

How many times a day do you explain what a crown is? What a root canal involves? Let the videos do the heavy lifting so you and your team can focus on what you do best: providing care.

Keep Visitors on Your Website Longer

Pages with video keep visitors engaged longer, which means better search rankings, more time learning about your practice, and more appointments booked.

Put Patients at Ease

Dental anxiety is real. A clear, professional walkthrough of what to expect helps patients feel calm and prepared before they even sit in the chair.

Chairside Player Included

Your subscription also includes a dedicated video player for the operatory. Pull up any video on an iPad, tablet, or op-room PC and walk patients through their treatment plan right at the chair. No app download needed.

Works Beautifully on Every Device

Videos look stunning on desktop, tablet, and mobile. They stream in crisp 4K quality with closed captions, fullscreen support, and smooth playback on every browser and device your patients use.

Free to Try

Install the plugin, browse the full library, preview every video, and build your pages, all for free. When you’re ready to go live, a Toothority subscription activates full-quality streaming on your website and unlocks the chairside player for your operatory.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any page or post and add a “Dental Video” block.
  3. Browse the library and pick a video. It previews right in the editor.
  4. Publish. Your patients can start watching immediately.
sections.faq:
Do I Need a Subscription?

You can install the plugin and preview every video for free. To stream full-quality videos on your live website, you need a Toothority subscription ($99/mo + one-time $129 setup).

What Happens Without a Subscription?

Videos won’t play on your live site. Visitors will see a placeholder instead. The editor preview continues to work so you can build and test your pages before subscribing.

What Topics Are Available?

Over 40 videos across 10 categories: General & Preventive, Restorative, Implants, Periodontics, Endodontics, Oral Surgery, Orthodontics, Prosthetics, Pediatric, and more. New videos are added regularly.

Will My Existing Videos Still Work After Updating?

Yes. If you’re upgrading from an earlier version, all your existing video blocks are automatically updated. No action needed on your part.
